composition.serve_who: This sheet serves the starboard Battery Eliminator Line (BEL) modules, specifically BEL1-S and BEL2-S, detailing their control, communication (CAN-A), and synchronization wiring. The sheet evidence is the prominent title blocks 'BEL1-S' and 'BEL2-S' alongside BAE system naming conventions.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The top half of the schematic is explicitly labeled 'BEL1-S' and maps its pinout, communication networks, and sync chain.

functions.label: Control and Communication Interface
functions.what_it_does: Connects the BEL1-S module to the vessel's CAN-A network, sync chain, and battery return for operational coordination.

flow_scenarios.path: CAN communications path routes CANA_HI from pin 5 via wire G3-S3AH to CAN-A HI, CANA_LO from pin 6 via wire G3-S3AL to CAN-A LO, and CANA_Shield from pin N/C via wire G3-S3AS to CAN-A Shield.
Synchronization path crosses signals: CHAIN_OUTPUT from pin 11 via wire G3-S321 routes to SYNC pin 3; SYNC from pin 3 via wire G3-S3S2 routes to SYNC pin 10.
VBATTERY RTN from pin 7 via wire G3-S3R1 connects to BEL RTN1; CHAIN_SUPPLY from pin 10 via wire G3-S3S3 connects to terminal pin 4.
ENABLE (pin 1 via G3-S329), ADR_0 (pin 8 via G3-S300a), and ADR_1 (pin 9 via G3-S300b) terminate as Not Connected (N/C). FREQ_SELECT (pin 2 via G3-S3S1) remains unconnected.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The bottom half of the schematic is explicitly labeled 'BEL2-S' and maps its identical pinout, communication networks, and sync chain.

functions.label: Control and Communication Interface
functions.what_it_does: Connects the BEL2-S module to the vessel's CAN-A network, sync chain, and battery return for operational coordination.

flow_scenarios.path: CAN communications path routes CANA_HI from pin 5 via wire G3-S4AH to CAN-A HI, CANA_LO from pin 6 via wire G3-S4AL to CAN-A LO, and CANA_Shield from pin N/C via wire G3-S4AS to CAN-A Shield.
Synchronization path crosses signals: CHAIN_OUTPUT from pin 11 via wire G3-S421 routes to SYNC pin 4; SYNC from pin 3 via wire G3-S4S2 routes to SYNC pin 9.
VBATTERY RTN from pin 7 via wire G3-S4R1 connects to BEL RTN1; CHAIN_SUPPLY from pin 10 via wire G3-S4S3 connects to terminal pin 4.
ENABLE (pin 1 via G3-S429), ADR_0 (pin 8 via G3-S400a), and ADR_1 (pin 9 via G3-S400b) terminate as Not Connected (N/C). FREQ_SELECT (pin 2 via G3-S4S1) remains unconnected.

facts: CAN-A network provides a common communications bus (HI, LO, Shield) for the Starboard BEL modules.
BEL RTN1 serves as the common battery return reference for both BEL1-S and BEL2-S modules.
The SYNC network provides crossed synchronization and chain connections for inter-module coordination (BEL1-S connects to pins 3/10, BEL2-S connects to pins 4/9).
